title: Index Non-Overlapping AI Evaluation Windows

company_style_tags.relevance_rationale: Practices precise evaluation cohort assignment and boundary semantics without claiming employer provenance.

learning_objectives: Resolve point queries with binary search.
problem_statement: Implement `EvaluationWindowIndex`. `add(start, end, label)` inserts a labeled half-open interval `[start, end)`. Bounds must be finite numbers, `start < end`, and labels must be non-empty. Intervals may touch but must not overlap; reject overlap and duplicate labels with `ValueError`. Insertion order is arbitrary. `find(timestamp)` returns the label whose interval contains the finite timestamp or `None`. `windows()` returns an immutable tuple of `(start, end, label)` entries sorted by start. Use binary search for point lookup and do not expose mutable internal state.
candidate_instructions: Use only the Python standard library.
Define touching and boundary behavior before implementation.
interviewer_instructions: Ask which neighbors must be checked after a bisect insertion point.
Do not reveal the exact bisect key.
constraints: Bounds and query timestamps are finite numbers.
assumptions: Evaluation windows are one-dimensional event-time cohorts.
Deletion and interval merging are outside the base scope.
expected_clarifying_questions: What is returned outside every window?

hints.text: After finding the insertion position, only the immediate predecessor and successor can overlap.
For lookup, bisect on interval starts and inspect the predecessor.

strong_answer_indicators: Separates label uniqueness from interval ordering.
weak_answer_indicators: Linear point lookup despite a sorted index.
Boundary behavior changes by insertion order.
follow_up_questions: How would you support overlapping windows with priorities?
How would you atomically replace an evaluation cohort schedule?
harder_variants: Return every overlapping window with priority ordering.
easier_variants: Construct once from already sorted intervals.

mode_specification.input_specification: Construct an index, add labeled half-open windows, and query timestamps.
mode_specification.output_specification: find returns a label or None; windows returns a sorted immutable tuple; invalid or overlapping additions raise ValueError.
